searchText: Is there any existing eof parse tool to parse EOF bytecodes? I built eofparse: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/29518/files#diff-7c19992b09d1bcf0442a05c4c84784ef02f569b26dc897152f99ea157667f0f2R85 Besu has a pretty printer in it's main line - https://github.com/hyperledger/besu -- `evmtool prettyprint <bytecode>` Here's Besu's PR for `CancunEOFTime` - https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/pull/7227 - branch is https://github.com/shemnon/besu/tree/eof/cancunEOF-fork In revm it prints both EOF (if it starts with xEF) or legacy if not. It is called from revm repo with `cargo run -p revme bytecode 0xEF00123`
